mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_settings (user_id, language, date_format, desktop_notify, sound_notify, weekly_report, analysis_engine, data_retention, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{language}, #{dateFormat}, #{desktopNotify}, #{soundNotify}, #{weeklyReport}, #{analysisEngine}, #{dataRetention}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE language = VALUES(language), date_format = VALUES(date_format), desktop_notify = VALUES(desktop_notify), sound_notify = VALUES(sound_notify), weekly_report = VALUES(weekly_report), analysis_engine = VALUES(analysis_engine), data_retention = VALUES(data_retention), updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user_settings WHERE data_retention IN ('30', '90')
